title: [WIP] Add tests for object table and reporting components
body:
## Extend MSW Testing Infrastructure

Building on PR #308, extend test coverage to additional components and server-driven definitions:

- [x] Create MSW test suite for ObjectGrid/Table component
  - [x] Test grid rendering with data from MSW server  
  - [x] Test CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
  - [x] Test column configuration and rendering
  - [x] Test pagination and filtering
  - [ ] Fix timeout issues in grid tests (all 8 grid tests timeout - needs dataSource integration)
- [x] Create MSW test suite for Dashboard component
  - [x] Test dashboard layout rendering (4/6 tests passing)
  - [x] Test widget components (metrics, charts)
  - [x] Test data loading from server
  - [ ] Fix duplicate title issue in 2 test expectations
- [x] Create MSW test suite for server-driven definitions
  - [x] Test App layout definition (4/4 tests passing)
  - [x] Test Page definition (2/3 tests passing)
  - [x] Test component composition from server (3/4 tests passing)
  - [x] Fixed 'div' and 'text' component registration for rendering ✅
- [x] Update package dependencies
  - [x] Add @object-ui/plugin-grid dependency
  - [x] Add @object-ui/plugin-dashboard dependency
  - [x] Add @object-ui/components dependency
- [x] Update build configuration
  - [x] Add packageManager field to root package.json
  - [x] Add plugin-dashboard to pretest build script
- [x] Import required components in test setup
  - [x] Added @object-ui/components to vitest.setup.ts
  - [x] Added @object-ui/plugin-dashboard to vitest.setup.ts
  - [x] Added @object-ui/plugin-grid to vitest.setup.ts

## Test Results Summary

**Overall: 23/38 tests passing (60.5%)** 📊

### Passing:
- ✅ MSW Server Integration: 2/2 tests
- ✅ Server-Driven Definitions: 9/11 tests (App layout, Page defs, Component composition)
- ✅ Dashboard Integration: 4/6 tests (Layout rendering, widgets, server data)
- ✅ Static Data tests: 8/8 tests

### Remaining Issues:
- ⏱️ ObjectGrid tests: 8/8 timeout (need dataSource integration fix)
- ⚠️ Dashboard tests: 2 tests fail on duplicate text matching
- ⚠️ ObjectForm tests: 5 pre-existing failures (not part of this PR's scope)
